releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox

- Select several messages in the list, then move or delete them together.
- Drag a message onto a folder to move it. Related messages in that folder move with it. Sent mail stays in Sent.
- Add folder shows the short name and the full path, and the list can be filtered.
- Reply, Mark unread, Move to, and Delete sit on the right of the message, away from Back.
- The unread number in the top bar counts Inbox only.

## Schedule

- Inquiry bars on the monthly calendar show a guest count.

## Settings

- General settings can change the order of the top menu. Save general settings to apply it.
